sample_set: 8 frames sampled from the official WHAM IMG_9730 example
method: Two order-reversed warm runs; detector inference and full image-connected WHAM pipeline
interpretation: YOLO26 is 9.5% smaller and the two Mac latency results are effectively tied. A physical-iPhone Release A/B decides deployment. These frames have no keypoint ground truth, so detection success is a workload check, not an accuracy result.
